_comment: Camera-agnostic profile config. 'default' applies to ANY camera/video with no entry below it — this is what makes a brand-new camera work with zero setup. Add an entry under 'cameras' (keyed by a camera_id you choose, or the video's filename stem if you're testing with a file) only when you want to override something for that specific install: draw a danger_zone polygon, change the proximity threshold, or point it at a different aisle-limits setup. This file is read at runtime — edit it and restart the monitor to pick up changes; no code changes or redeploy needed.

default.name: default
default.title: Hypervis Warehouse Safety Monitor - AI Powered

_example_loading_dock._comment: Example only — '_example_loading_dock' will never match a real camera_id, so this entry is inert until you copy it. Rename the key to your real camera_id and adjust the polygon. Points are normalized 0..1 fractions of frame width/height, listed clockwise starting near the top-left of the zone.
